# Paper Lab

> A modern academic paper editor designed specifically for IEEE and journal formats.

## Overview
Paper Lab is a platform that features an intuitive IEEE & Journal WYSIWYG editor, priority cloud compiles, and a built-in vector diagram editor.

## Key Features
- **IEEE & Journal WYSIWYG Editor**: Write academic papers visually with automated formatting for IEEE, Elsevier, Springer, and other journal templates.
- **Priority Cloud Compiles**: Fast and reliable publication PDF generation in the cloud.
- **WYSIWYG Diagram Editor**: Create diagrams visually and embed them seamlessly into your papers.

## Official Resources
- **Website**: [Paper Lab](https://paperlab.r3actr.com)
